comment: Capability declaration for the DAWproject interchange format.
Import rows are the authority for the importer's documented subset: the
importer asks this table before admitting a construct, so a row flipped to
'none' turns the corresponding construct into a refusal.
Export rows are the authority for the writer's BOUNDED subset. A row rated
'full' must be a concept core/dawproject/src/dawproject_export.cpp actually
emits -- its kImplementedExports static_assert fails the build otherwise, so
the table can never promise more than the writer delivers.

asset.referenced-media.notes: package-relative locator retained verbatim; identity sealed to the resolved bytes

clip.media-window.loss: the writer references the complete media asset, so a nonzero source start or partial frame count is dropped

asset.embedded-media.loss: the writer does not emit embedded media bytes, so an embedded asset is omitted

clip.absolute.loss: the writer cannot place sample-anchored clips on its beats-only lane, so the clip and its content are omitted

take.lane.loss: the writer does not inspect take lanes, so alternate takes are omitted

take.comp.loss: the writer does not flatten comp selections, so comp segment choices are omitted

track.freeze.loss: DAWproject has no freeze concept; the authored track is exported and the sealed render is dropped

clip.gain.loss: the writer does not emit a clip gain, so an authored clip gain is dropped and the clip exports at unity

clip.fades.loss: the writer does not emit clip fades, so authored fade-in and fade-out shapes are dropped and the clip exports with hard edges

clip.note-modifier.loss: DAWproject notes carry no probability, pass condition, or ratchet; the notes are written and play unconditionally once

automation.device-param.loss: device identity does not survive without a device payload, so its automation has no target

mixer.track-gain.loss: the writer does not emit a channel volume, so an authored track gain is dropped and the track exports at unity

mixer.track-pan.loss: the writer does not emit a channel pan, so an authored track pan is dropped and the track exports centred

automation.track-gain.loss: a volume automation lane has no export target while channel volume itself is dropped

automation.track-pan.loss: a pan automation lane has no export target while channel pan itself is dropped

device.placement.loss: devices are identity-only in the document; DAWproject requires a device type to place one

sequence.multiple.loss: only the root sequence is written; other sequences are dropped

content.registered.loss: the writer cannot preserve registered extension payloads, so the clip content is omitted

content.opaque.loss: the writer cannot preserve opaque extension payloads, so the clip content is omitted

marker.loss: the writer does not emit markers or regions, so every named point and range on the timeline is dropped

timecode.origin.loss: the writer does not emit a session timecode origin, so the exported document starts at zero and every timecode reference shifts

tempo.ramp.loss: the writer emits only its first constant tempo, so continuous tempo curves are dropped with the rest of the tempo map

sequence.section-role.loss: DAWproject arrangement markers carry a name and span but no typed structural role

context.chord-bass.loss: the DAWproject chord representation carries quality and root but no bass

context.chord-extension.loss: the DAWproject chord representation carries no added scale degrees

context.chord-voicing.loss: the DAWproject chord representation carries no voicing hint

tuning.project.loss: DAWproject has no document-wide tuning statement

tuning.instrument.loss: DAWproject has no per-instrument tuning statement
